mintedBy: Acquisition builder (2026-09-26). Topps Living Set is a genuinely absent product -- card_catalog holds ZERO rows for any Living Set spelling (topps-living, topps-living-set both load 0). Debuted March 2018; continuous weekly-release numbering that never resets across years (1953-Topps-style base design, artwork by Mayumi Seto, print-to-order, no serial numbers on base cards). 2,373 sold_comps sales are mis-keyed under bare `topps` at hiq:baseball:2018:topps:<n>:base:no-auto because computeHobbyIqCardId collapses the unregistered setKey topps-living-set to flagship topps (confirmed empirically, see PROBE note in MANIFEST.md).

rungsMinted.parallel: (none -- single-rung product, no stated parallel ladder)

parallelLadder.reason: Both sources state explicitly that base Living Set carries no parallel/color ladder for 2018. baseballcardpedia: 'Each player will have one, and only one, Living Set card UNLESS that player changes teams.' Neither source's 2018 section mentions any colored/serial-numbered variant. The only later variant either source documents (a 'Black Text' first-ten-copies micro-variant, not serial-numbered) begins in 2023 (#595+), well outside this package's scope. Per the topps-mini (1975) PR's convention: parallel column left BLANK, never 'Base' -- blank means no sourced parallel exists, not 'unknown'.

checklistCards.reason: This product periodically issues its own unnumbered 'Checklist #N' insert cards bundled with a release week (e.g. CL-01/CL-02 in 2019, CL-03 in 2020, CL-07 in 2024). None fall in the 2018 window. Per doctrine, a checklist/index card names no player and is not staged as a priceable card.

spellingAudit: Card numbers, player names and release dates taken verbatim from baseballcardpedia.com's single continuous 'Topps Living Set' wiki page (2018 subsection). Print runs and player names cross-checked card-for-card against cardboardconnection.com's independent 'Ultimate Topps Living Set Baseball Cards Checklist Breakdown Guide' page -- all 126 cards agree exactly on print run; the two sources are complementary rather than conflicting (baseballcardpedia gives release date but no team; cardboardconnection gives team but no release date). One cosmetic difference only: baseballcardpedia renders accented/suffixed names with diacritics/commas ("Ronald Acuña, Jr."), cardboardconnection without ("Ronald Acuna") -- same player, house-style difference, not a disagreement. cardboardconnection's own page has one self-typo ("San Deigo Padres" for card #24) corrected to "San Diego Padres" in this CSV's team column (visible in MANIFEST.md, not silently fixed).

provenance.cardsFrom: baseballcardpedia.com (cardNumber, player, releaseDate) cross-corroborated by cardboardconnection.com (cardNumber, player, team, printRun) -- print run and player/number agree exactly across both sources for all 126 rows.
provenance.rungsFrom: n/a -- no parallel ladder sourced; see notMinted.parallelLadder
provenance.dedup: card_catalog holds zero rows under topps-living, topps-living-set, or any other Living Set spelling for any year -- confirmed read-only, 2026-09-26.
